title: Debt collector communication rules
facts: Covered debt collectors generally may not contact a consumer at unusual or inconvenient times or places; communications before 8 a.m. or after 9 p.m. local time are generally presumed inconvenient unless circumstances indicate otherwise.
A debt collector generally must stop communicating after receiving a valid written cease-communication request, subject to limited permitted notices.
Collectors may not harass, oppress, abuse, use deceptive practices or threaten actions they cannot legally take.
Special rules apply when a collector knows the consumer is represented by an attorney regarding the debt.
